name: LM Evaluation Harness

summary.en: Evaluate a local causal language model on supplied examples.
summary.zh: 使用本地样本评测本地因果语言模型。

license: MIT; local model and dataset licenses remain separate
input_description: inputs.data: JSON {records:[{context,continuation,choices,target_index}]}; inputs.model_dir: local HF directory with safetensors weights. All paths stay inside the paper workspace.

25.en: Check the likelihood of supplied reference completions.
25.zh: 辅助检查给定参考回答的似然。

75.en: Run the multiple-choice evaluation module and report predictions and accuracy.
75.zh: 承担多选评测模块，输出选择结果及准确率。

100.en: Complete the bounded evaluation with reference likelihoods, choice ranking, and deterministic generation.
100.zh: 完成限定样本的似然、多选及确定性生成评测。

limitations: Requires an explicitly supplied local model; no automatic download or API calls.
No general research-idea quality judge. Results apply only to supplied data.
Choice ranking uses unnormalized log-likelihood; unequal completion lengths may affect ranking.
The bundled tiny-model example uses random weights solely to check integration.

name: Inspect AI

summary.en: Score recorded Agent outputs against reference answers.
summary.zh: 对已有 Agent 输出按参考答案评分并比较。

input_description: inputs.data: JSON {records:[{id,input,output,target,group,baseline_output,tokens?,cost?}]}. Groups required for 75/100; matched baseline outputs required for 100.

25.en: Check outputs with Inspect's exact reference-answer scorer.
25.zh: 使用 Inspect 的参考答案匹配辅助检查输出。

75.en: Handle the replay-scoring module, including subgroup results.
75.zh: 承担记录评分模块，并按任务分组分析。

100.en: Complete paired baseline comparison and summarize recorded resource use.
100.zh: 完成同题基线对比，并汇总记录中的资源使用。

limitations: Evaluates supplied records only; no live Agent is executed.
Exact-answer checks do not evaluate open-ended research quality or prove Agent improvement.
Token and cost totals are reported only when every input record supplies them.

name: SAM 2.1 Tiny

summary.en: Segment an image using local pretrained SAM 2.1 weights.
summary.zh: 用本地 SAM 2.1 权重完成图像分割。

license: Apache-2.0 (SAM 2 code and checkpoints); bundled components carry their own notices
input_description: inputs.image: RGB image; inputs.checkpoint: local sam2.1_hiera_tiny.pt; inputs.prompts: JSON {points:[[x,y]],labels:[1],box?:[x1,y1,x2,y2]} for 25/75. params.device: cpu or cuda.

25.en: Produce one mask from supplied point prompts for a local check.
25.zh: 根据给定点击提示生成单个掩码，辅助局部检查。

75.en: Handle point/box-guided segmentation and return alternative masks.
75.zh: 承担点击或边框引导的分割模块，返回候选掩码。

100.en: Complete bounded automatic mask proposal and export masks with quality estimates.
100.zh: 完成限定采样范围的自动分割，导出掩码及质量估计。

limitations: Image segmentation only; does not perform OpenVLA action inference or LIBERO rollout.
Requires a locally supplied official tiny checkpoint; runtime never downloads it.
Predicted IoU is a model estimate; measured accuracy requires ground-truth masks.
Tier 100 uses a bounded grid and can legitimately return zero surviving masks.
